text:
Residents:
Felix (40s): Weekdays home AM, out 1:40 PM–11 PM. Weekends off, errands midday. Hobbies: movies, houseplants.
Aisha (50s): WFH 9 AM–5:30 PM weekdays. Weekends sleep in, errands midday. Hobbies: friends, meditation, movies.
Ines (30s): WFH 9 AM–5:30 PM weekdays. Weekends sleep in, errands midday. Hobbies: baking, reading, running.

Object Locations & Routines:
Felix’s items (backpack, jacket, keys, phone, scarf, shoes, sunglasses, umbrella, wallet, water bottle) are typically at the entry (hook/table/floor) in the morning. They are removed from the house around 16:00 when he leaves for work and return around 00:00 when he comes home. His personal dishes (bowl, glass, mug, plate) are usually in the kitchen sink or cupboard in the morning, moved to the cupboard by 12:00, and returned to the sink/table by 16:00.

Aisha’s and Ines’s phones are usually on their respective nightstands (b2/b3) overnight. They are removed from the house around 08:00 for work/errands and return by 12:00. Aisha’s laptop is on her desk (b2) during work hours (12:00–16:00) and moved to the floor or nightstand in the evening. Ines’s headphones and water bottle are on her desk (b3) during work hours and moved to the nightstand or kitchen in the evening.

Shared kitchen items (cutting board, knife, pan, pot, recipe book, spatula, snack bowl) are usually in the cupboard or pantry overnight. They are moved to the counter or sink during the day (12:00–20:00) for cooking/cleaning and returned to storage by 00:00.

Personal dishes for Aisha and Ines (bowls, glasses, mugs, plates) are usually in the cupboard overnight. They are moved to the sink, dish rack, or kitchen table during the day and returned to the cupboard by 00:00.

Notes:
- Felix is out of the house from ~16:00 to ~00:00 on weekdays.
- Aisha and Ines are home all day on weekdays, working from 9 AM to 5:30 PM.
- No items have been taken out of the house permanently; all "not in any room" items returned by the next patrol.
- Pockets and bags are not inspected.
